title: Factory Pattern Recipe — Companion Resources
description: Runnable factory pattern examples: factory method notifications (TypeScript), simple factory payment providers (Python), abstract factory UI themes (Java), a minimal DI container (TypeScript), a factory+builder combo (TypeScript) and an async pooled connection factory (Python/asyncpg).
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables del patrón factory: factory method de notificaciones (TypeScript), simple factory de proveedores de pago (Python), abstract factory de temas UI (Java), contenedor DI mínimo (TypeScript), combo factory+builder (TypeScript) y factory async con pool de conexiones (Python/asyncpg).
